description: Time Machine is an AI-powered corporate learning platform. This plugin lets ChatGPT create and manage courses, modules, topics, lessons, exercises, quiz questions, learning bytes, users, departments, roles, and demo trainings inside your company's Time Machine workspace. It also reads student progress, insights, certificates, and expert assignments. 123 operations run against your company via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE — ChatGPT sees only the data your Time Machine account can access. Best for L&D teams, sales enablement, and admins managing corporate training at scale.
